author: JKawesome
body:
Hey guys! Here's another map that I made. This time it's Christmas themed, featuring a huge Christmas tree in the middle, snowy islands, and hidden diamonds. This map was inspired by some of my favorite maps, including Halcyon and Senex. There are 28 blocks of iron for each side, and a few diamond blocks hidden.

Some screenshots:






Full image album here: http://imgur.com/a/bokC9#0

Download link (YML is in the zip): http://www.mediafire.com/download/1rrrg33c397cbba/Aeternum.zip

Loadout:
- Stone sword
- Bow
- Efficiency II pickaxe
- 2 Golden apples
- 16 steak
- 16 logs
- 32 glass
- 64 arrows

replies.body: I really like the simple, uncluttered feel but I really feel like the snow plains on either side of the Christmas tree could be a more decorative and more aesthetically pleasing. and if there is diamonds in the middle it will be like Zalidor which ever team gets the middle island will dominate for the rest of the match pretty much. Just my 2 cents.

replies.author: cinammoncroc000
replies.body:
Looks like a JKawesome map to me!

The map is a very nice size for a 15v15 team limit, and the Christmas theme adds a nice touch to what would otherwise be a bland map. A bit more variation in the floor of the islands would be preferable (imo), but overall it looks pretty nice to me :)

+1
